known_issues: Drug Interaction checker does not display fully updated results after manual data entry when running Drug-Drug, Drug-Food, and Food-Food interaction checks.

existing_features.title: Replace the stubbed interaction-check hooks with real client-side React Query queries so that clicking "Check interactions" returns and displays the latest results based on the current manually-entered inputs for: Drug-Drug (multi-drug), Drug-Food, and Food-Food.

Implement and enforce input validation for manual interaction checks across Drug-Drug, Drug-Food, and Food-Food before running the check, and display clear English validation messages in the module when validation fails.

Ensure that interaction results shown in the Drug Interaction module are computed from the current local datasets/indexes and are not blocked by backend availability, including: drug-drug lookups via the local drug-drug interaction dataset/index, drug-food lookups via the drug-food dataset/index, and food-food lookups via the food-food dataset/index.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix Drug Interaction section so that when manually entering data and checking Drug-Drug, Drug-Food, or Food-Food interactions, clicking 'Check interactions' shows fully updated results (including required validation).

projectName: Fix Drug Interaction checker to show fully updated results after manual entry (Drug-Drug, Drug-Food, Food-Food)
